description: The claims say `"recorded": "false"` — a word, not a boolean — with nothing under the log directory. Point 7 verified the pass only when the flag was exactly `true`, and every rendering read it as truthy: before 2026-09-28 the lie stayed in the sub-heading ("recorded", "**Recorded.**"), and the day the status sentence started reading the flag it would have put `Status: conformant` on a report whose pass nobody verified. A flag in words is refused before anything reads it; the claims have no schema, and a hand edit is exactly how a word gets there (the review of PR #32 built this input and watched it pass).
